linkedin:
Nostr WoT 0.8.13 expands account recovery without collapsing every fallback into one promise.

Version 0.8.13 is live in both Chrome and Firefox. Compatible passkeys can protect a vault, provider storage can hold an encrypted full-vault snapshot, recovery files remain available, and relay recovery requires an explicit action.

Availability is not recovery.

We separated provider acknowledgements, relay availability and actual restore checks because each proves something different. The same release adds a full-tab event archive and preserves uncertain NWC payments from automatic retry.

Passkey providers still need WebAuthn PRF support, and neither store listing proves Safari availability.

nostr:
Nostr WoT 0.8.13 is live in Chrome and Firefox.

Compatible passkeys can protect and recover a vault through provider storage, an encrypted file or explicit relay recovery. The release also adds a full-tab event archive and avoids automatic retry when an NWC payment outcome is unknown.

Provider support does not prove cross-device sync, and relay availability does not prove a snapshot is current.
